summary_zh: 经典的祖鲁民间生态传说，讲述响蜜鴷恩格德与贪婪年轻猎人格吉莱的故事。小鸟引路带领格吉莱在空心大树中找到了蜂巢，猎人取出诱人蜂蜜饱餐后，却背弃世代相传的互助约定，未给带路鸟留下半点蜂蜡，独自逃离。被激怒的响蜜鴷在数周后再次呼唤格吉莱，格吉莱以为又将有美餐，兴冲冲跟随小鸟穿过丛林爬上一棵无花果树，却迎面撞上一只凶猛的花豹。侥幸逃生的格吉莱自此铭记教训，而猎人们也世代告诫：永远不要忘记与响蜜鴷分享猎物。

sentences.text: This is the story of Ngede, the Honeyguide, and a greedy young man named Gingile.
sentences.translation_zh: 这是关于响蜜鴷恩格德和一个名叫格吉莱的贪婪年轻人的故事。

sentences.text: One day while Gingile was out hunting he heard the call of Ngede.
sentences.translation_zh: 有一天，当格吉莱外出打猎时，他听到了恩格德的叫声。

sentences.text: Gingile’s mouth began to water at the thought of honey.
sentences.translation_zh: 一想到蜂蜜，格吉莱嘴里就开始流口水。

sentences.text: He stopped and listened carefully, searching until he saw the bird in the branches above his head.
sentences.translation_zh: 他停下脚步仔细倾听，四处寻找，直到看见头顶树枝间的那只小鸟。

sentences.text: “Chitik-chitik-chitik,” the little bird rattled, as he flew to the next tree, and the next.
sentences.translation_zh: “哧啼-哧啼-哧啼”，这只小鸟叫声清脆，一棵树接一棵树地往前飞。

tokens.gloss_zh: 咔哒鸣叫；发出连珠啼鸣

sentences.text: “Chitik, chitik, chitik,” he called, stopping from time to time to be sure that Gingile followed.
sentences.translation_zh: 它“哧啼、哧啼、哧啼”地叫着，不时停下来确认格吉莱有没有跟上。

sentences.text: After half an hour, they reached a huge wild fig tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 半小时后，他们来到了一棵巨大的野生无花果树前。

sentences.text: Ngede hopped about madly among the branches.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德在树枝间兴奋地蹦来跳去。

sentences.text: He then settled on one branch and cocked his head at Gingile as if to say, “Here it is!
sentences.translation_zh: 然后它落在一个树枝上，歪着头看着格吉莱，仿佛在说：“就在这里！

sentences.text: Come now!
sentences.translation_zh: 快来吧！

sentences.text: What is taking you so long?”
sentences.translation_zh: 你怎么磨蹭这么久呀？”

tokens.gloss_zh: 助动词（构成现在进行时）

sentences.text: Gingile couldn’t see any bees from under the tree, but he trusted Ngede.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱站在树下看不见任何蜜蜂，但他信任恩格德。

sentences.text: Gingile left his spear under the tree and climbed toward the sound of the bees.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱把长矛留在树下，顺着蜜蜂的嗡嗡声往上爬。

sentences.text: He drove them out with smoke, but several stung him before they flew away.
sentences.translation_zh: 他用烟雾把蜜蜂熏了出来，但在蜜蜂飞走前，有几只蜇了他。

sentences.text: When the bees were out, Gingile pushed his hands into the nest.
sentences.translation_zh: 蜜蜂飞出后，格吉莱把双手伸进了蜂巢。

sentences.text: He took out handfuls of the heavy comb, dripping with rich honey and full of fat, white grubs.
sentences.translation_zh: 他掏出一捧捧沉甸甸的蜂巢，上面滴着浓稠的蜂蜜，爬满了白胖的幼虫。

sentences.text: He put the comb carefully in the pouch he carried on his shoulder, and started to climb down the tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 他小心翼翼地把蜂巢放进挂在肩上的袋子里，然后开始爬下树。

sentences.text: Ngede eagerly watched everything that Gingile was doing.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德急切地注视着格吉莱的一举一动。

tokens.gloss_zh: 助动词（构成过去进行时）

sentences.text: He was waiting for him to leave a fat piece of honeycomb as a thank-you offering to the Honeyguide.
sentences.translation_zh: 它在等格吉莱留下一块肥厚的蜂巢，作为送给响蜜鴷的谢礼。

tokens.gloss_zh: 助动词（构成过去进行时）

sentences.text: Ngede flittered from branch to branch, closer and closer to the ground.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德在枝桠间飞来跳去，离地面越来越近。

phrases.gloss_zh: 从一根树枝到另一根树枝

sentences.text: Finally Gingile reached the bottom of the tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱终于爬到了树底。

sentences.text: Ngede perched on a rock near the boy and waited for his reward.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德栖息在年轻人身旁的岩石上，等待着它的回报。

sentences.text: But, Gingile put out the fire, picked up his spear and started walking home, ignoring the bird.
sentences.translation_zh: 但是格吉莱扑灭了火，捡起长矛，对那只鸟视而不见，径直迈步往家走。

sentences.text: Ngede called out angrily, “VIC-torr!
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德愤怒地高声尖叫：“维克-托！”

sentences.text: VIC-torrr!”
Gingile stopped, stared at the little bird and laughed aloud.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱停住脚，盯着那只小鸟，放声大笑起来。

sentences.text: “You want some honey, do you, my friend?
sentences.translation_zh: “你想要些蜂蜜是吧，我的朋友？

sentences.text: Ha!
sentences.translation_zh: 哈！

sentences.text: But I did all the work, and got all the stings.
sentences.translation_zh: 可所有的力气都是我出的，所有的蜇咬也是我挨的！

sentences.text: Why should I share any of this lovely honey with you?”
sentences.translation_zh: 我凭什么要分给你这么美味的蜂蜜呢？”

phrases.surface: share any of this lovely honey with

sentences.text: Then he walked off.
sentences.translation_zh: 说完他就大摇大摆地走了。

sentences.text: Ngede was furious!
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德愤怒极了。

sentences.text: This was no way to treat him!
sentences.translation_zh: 绝不能容许有人这样对待它！

sentences.text: But he would get his revenge.
sentences.translation_zh: 它一定要报复。

sentences.text: One day several weeks later Gingile again heard the honey call of Ngede.
sentences.translation_zh: 几周后的一天，格吉莱再次听到了恩格德召唤取蜜的叫声。

sentences.text: He remembered the delicious honey, and eagerly followed the bird once again.
sentences.translation_zh: 他想起了那美味的蜂蜜，又急切地跟着这只鸟走去。

sentences.text: After leading Gingile along the edge of the forest, Ngede stopped to rest in a great umbrella thorn.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德领着格吉莱沿着森林边缘走了一阵，停在一棵巨大的金合欢树上歇息。

sentences.text: “Ahh,” thought Gingile.
sentences.translation_zh: “啊哈，”格吉莱心想。

sentences.text: “The hive must be in this tree.”
sentences.translation_zh: “蜂巢肯定在这棵树里！”

sentences.text: He began to climb, sure he would find honey again.
sentences.translation_zh: 他满心以为又能找到蜂蜜，便开始攀爬起来。

sentences.text: Ngede sat and watched.
sentences.translation_zh: 恩格德在旁边坐着看着。

sentences.text: Gingile climbed, wondering why he didn’t hear the usual buzzing.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱一边往上爬，一边纳闷为什么听不到往常那种嗡嗡声。

sentences.text: “Perhaps the hive is deep in the tree,” he thought to himself.
sentences.translation_zh: “也许蜂窝在树洞很深的地方，”他心里想。

sentences.text: He pulled himself up another branch.
sentences.translation_zh: 他用力把自己拉上另一根树枝。

sentences.text: But instead of the hive, he was staring into the face of a leopard!
sentences.translation_zh: 但映入眼帘的不是蜂巢，而是正面相对的一张花豹的面孔！

tokens.gloss_zh: 助动词（构成过去进行时）

sentences.text: Leopard was very angry at having her sleep so rudely interrupted.
sentences.translation_zh: 花豹因为好梦被人如此粗暴地打扰而怒不可遏。

sentences.text: She narrowed her eyes, opened her mouth to reveal her very large and very sharp teeth.
sentences.translation_zh: 她眯起双眼，张开大嘴，露出了极其巨大而锋利的獠牙。

sentences.text: Before Leopard could take a swipe at Gingile, he rushed down the tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 还没等花豹挥爪扑来，格吉莱就没命地往树下冲。

sentences.text: In his hurry he missed a branch, and landed with a heavy thud on the ground twisting his ankle.
sentences.translation_zh: 慌乱之中他踩空了一根树枝，“咚”的一声重重摔在地上，扭伤了脚踝。

sentences.text: He hobbled off as fast as he could.
sentences.translation_zh: 他拼尽全力一瘸一拐地逃开了。

tokens.gloss_zh: 正如（as fast as could结构）

sentences.text: Luckily for him, Leopard was still too sleepy to chase him.
sentences.translation_zh: 算他走运，花豹还困倦得懒得去追赶他。

phrases.gloss_zh: 太困了以至于懒得去追

sentences.text: Ngede, the Honeyguide, had his revenge.
sentences.translation_zh: 响蜜鴷恩格德成功报了仇。

sentences.text: And Gingile learned his lesson.
sentences.translation_zh: 格吉莱也吸取了惨痛的教训。

sentences.text: And so, when the children of Gingile hear the story of Ngede they have respect for the little bird.
sentences.translation_zh: 所以，当格吉莱的孩子们听到恩格德的故事时，他们对这只小鸟充满了敬意。

sentences.text: Whenever they harvest honey, they make sure to leave the biggest part of the comb for Honeyguide!
sentences.translation_zh: 每当他们收获蜂蜜时，都一定会留下最大的一块蜂巢送给响蜜鴷。

rights.author: Zulu folktale
rights.modifications: 严格依照原版民间故事结构改编为B2阅读材料，讲述猎人背信弃义遭遇响蜜鴷惩戒的生态寓言，提供逐句中文翻译与逐词语境释义。
